e01.saheli: Kaalai vanakkam Lakshmi ma! Reading romba nallaa irukku, kavalaiye pada vendam.
e01.text: Kaalai vanakkam Saheli! Ippo thaan check panninen, BP reading 132/87 nu vandhurukku. Normal ah nalla irukku illaiya?

e02.saheli: Padattam vendaam Lakshmi ma, konjam thanni kudinga. Prakash kitta sollunga, avar doctor kitta check panni solluvaar.
e02.text: Saheli, chinna confusion vandhuduchi pa. Kaalaile potta tablet marubadiyum pottutenonnu bayama irukku. Enna panradhu?

e03.saheli: Rumba nalla vishayam Lakshmi ma! Kandippa daily 6:30 pm walk timing note panni vachukuren.
e03.text: Saheli, nalaikku irundhu daily evening walk pogalamnu mudivu pannirukken. Daily 6:30 pm ku walk poven, neenga note panni vachukkonga.

e04.saheli: Prakash, ennala direct ah order poda mudiyaadhu. Neenga delivery app la oru pack brown bread book pannidunga please.
e04.text: Sorry for the late reply Saheli. Amma ku oru pack brown bread order panna mudiyuma?

h001.saheli: Vanakkam Prakash! Amma Lakshmi details note panniten, romba thanks. Naan ungalukku eppavum thunaiyaa irukken.
h001.text: Hi Saheli, setting up for my mother Lakshmi. Conditions: Type 2 diabetes on insulin, Hypothyroidism, Osteoarthritis (knees), High blood pressure. Medicines: none. Allergies: none. Doctor is Dr Keerthana Raman.

h002.saheli: Pakkathu veetukaaranga kooda pesinadhu ketka romba sandhosham Lakshmi ma. Manasukku nalla amaidhiyaa irundhirukkum!
h002.text: Namma pakkathu veetu Geetha vandhirundha pa. Romba naal kalichu paarthen, nalla pesitu irundhom. Manasuku romba niraivaa irundhuchu.

h003.saheli: Super ma, evening walk mudichadhu romba nalladhu. Nalla rest edunga ippo!
h003.text: Saheli, innaiku evening walk mudichuten pa. Kaal vali perusa illa, theru varaikkum medhuva poyitu vandhen. Nalla fresh-aa irukku.

h004.saheli: Aiyo tension aagatheenga Prakash, appappo ipdi aagum. Konjam rest edunga, take care.
h004.text: Sorry for the late reply. Konjam low-aa irukku innaiku, romba dull mood.

h005.saheli: Innaiku evening ungalukku perusa edhuvum schedule illa ma. Relax pannitu amaidhiyaa irunga!
h005.text: Saheli, innaiku evening edhavadhu schedule irukka pa? Naan enna pannanum nu sollu, marandhida koodadhu la.

h006.saheli: M. S. Subbulakshmi amma paattu ketradhe oru periya thavam dhaan ma. Kettute amaidhiyaa irunga!
h006.text: Enakku M. S. Subbulakshmi paattu na romba uyir pa. Dhinamum evening kandippa avanga paattu ketpen. Manasuke oru amaidhi tharum theriyuma.

h007.saheli: Nalla thoongineenga nu therinju romba sandhosham ma! Kaalaila nalla refreshment kedaichurukkum.
h007.text: Nethu raathiri nalla thoonginen pa. Endha thondharavum illa, kaalaila fresh-aa ezhundhuten. Romba nimmidhiyaa irukku.

h008.saheli: Pethi peranga pesinaale manasuku periya kushi dhaan Lakshmi ma! Nalla jolly-aa pesineengala?
h008.text: Pillaiyoda pasanga phone panni pesinaanga pa. Avanga seira kurumbu ellam solli sirithen. Pasanga kooda pesinaale manasuku periya santhosham dhaan.

h009.saheli: Aama ma, veyil jasthi dhaan. Nalla thanni kudichu fan kaathula rest edunga.
h009.text: Innaiku veyil romba adikkudhu pa inge. Kaathu kooda sarigai varala, ulla ukkandhirukken. Fan pottalum konjam thikkuna madhiri irukku.

h010.saheli: Kulirndha kaathu varradhu ketkave nallaa irukku ma. Mazhai vantha thappama paathu rasiga, badhrama irunga!
h010.text: Saheli, evening aagavum nalla chill-nu kaathu adikidhu pa. Mazhai varum pola irukku, megam ellam karuthu pochu. Romba idhamaana kaathula ukkandhirukken.

h011.saheli: Paravalla Prakash, nalla rest edunga. Nalla saaputtu thoongunga innaiku.
h011.text: Late reply-ku sorry. Romba tired-aa irukku work mudichitu vanthadhum.

h012.saheli: Poondu rasam maname thani dhaan Lakshmi ma! Prakash-kum ungalukkum nalla treats innaiku.
h012.text: Innaiku naan dhaan rasam vechen pa. Nalla poondu perungayam pottu manakka manakka senjen. Prakash-kum romba pudikum idhu.

h013.saheli: Amma-ku pongal romba pudikkum nu sonnadhu note pannikiten Prakash, arumayana choice!
h013.text: Sorry late reply. Amma-ku pongal na romba pudikkum, fav dish adhudhan.

h014.saheli: BP 139/84 note panniten Prakash. Thank you update pannadhukku!

h015.saheli: Innaiku saayantharam ungalukku edhum pending illa ma. Nalla tea kudichitu relax pannunga!

h016.saheli: BP 143/76 note panniten Lakshmi ma. Udamba nalla paathukonga, take rest!
h016.text: Innaiku doctor sonna madhiri BP check panninen pa, 143/76 vandhudhu. Nalla note panniko. Prakash kitta solliten.

h017.saheli: Romba nalladhu Prakash! Nalla thoongina dhaan body-kum mind-kum fresh feeling varum.
h017.text: Sorry late reply. Nethu night nalla thoonginen, felt good.

h018.text: Next week festival varudhu la, veetla cleaning and prep start panniyachu.

h019.saheli: Kulir kaathu super feeling dhaan Prakash. Enjoy pannitu nalla thoongu!
h019.text: Ippo nalla cold breezy weather inge. Very pleasant.

h020.saheli: Paravalla Prakash! Neighbours kooda appappo pesradhu nalladhu dhaan.
h020.text: Sorry for late reply. Pakkathu veetu uncle vandhu pesitu irundhaaru konjam neram.

h021.saheli: Vali illaama nalla thoongineenga nu kekka romba sandhoshamaa irukku ma! Innaiku naal inikkatum.
h021.text: Saheli, nethu raathiri romba sugame thoongiten pa. Vali onnum illaama amaidhiyaa irundhuchu. Kaalaila oru puthumai vandha maadhiri irukku.

h022.saheli: BP 118/72 note pannikiten Prakash. Nalla normal reading, romba thanks!

h024.text: Innaiku kaalaile irundhu kaathula oru eeram irukku pa. Megam moottama irukku, eppo venalum mazhai kottidum pola. Vaanam paakka romba azhagaa irukku.

h029.text: Festival shopping mudichitom, oorukku relatives varaporaanga.

h031.saheli: Kekkave sandhoshama irukku Lakshmi amma! Appappo neighbours kooda pesina manasukku nalla relief.
h031.text: Namma pakkathu veettu Vasantha maami inniku kaalaila vandhurundhaanga. Romba naal aachu paathu, nalla katha pesinom. She gave some murukku also.

h032.saheli: Family ellam vandhadhu romba nalla vishayam Lakshmi amma. Nalla rest eduthukkoanga.

h033.saheli: Nalla thookam dhaan udambukku mukkiyam Lakshmi amma. Romba sandhosham.
h033.text: Nethu raathiri nalla thookam vandhathu Saheli. Kaalaila ezhundha appo odambu romba lesa irundhathu. Mind kooda fresh-a irukku.

h034.saheli: Romba nalla seidhi Lakshmi amma! Kumar-ukku nalla future vara vazhthukkal.
h034.text: Edhir veettu Kumar paiyan college mudichu velaikku poga poranam. Avanga amma vandhu solli periya box laddu koduthaanga. Romba nalla paiyan.

h035.saheli: Jilu jilunu irundha filter coffee kudikka nalla irukkum Lakshmi amma! Mazhai vandha veliya pogaama pathrama irunga.
h035.text: Inniku Chennai-la climate sema jillunu aayiduchu. Vaanam muzhukka karuppa megam katti mazhai vara maadhiri irukku. Oru cup sooda filter coffee kudinga nu thonudhu.

h036.saheli: Snowy romba cute-a irukke Lakshmi amma! Pet kooda irundhale manasellam jolly aayidum.
h036.text: Namma veettu poona Snowy irukke, adhu madiyila vandhu paduthukittu ore konjal. Paal kudichutu sofa mela nalla thoongudhu. Paakka romba azhaga irukku.

h037.saheli: Oh no, romba kavalaiya irukku Prakash. Amma-va nalla paathukkoanga, doctor advice follow pannunga.
h037.text: Sorry for late text. Amma had a fall in the bathroom last night. Admitted her to Shanti Nursing Home, Chennai.

h038.saheli: Super Prakash! Simple rasam and potato fry dhaan best comfort food.
h038.text: Sorry for late reply. Today tried making simple rasam and potato fry for lunch.

h039.saheli: Kekkave amaidhiya irukku Lakshmi amma. Nalla rest edunga, udambu seekiram thevaikkum.
h039.text: Nethu raathiri nalla thoonitten Saheli. Yaaru disturb-um pannala, continuous-a thookam pochu. Ippo odambu romba thevalla nu thonudhu.

h040.text: Saheli, inniku sayandhram enakku enna medicine edukanum? Konjam paathu solluriya? Marandhuda koodadhu nu kekkaren.

h041.saheli: Romba nalla vishayam Prakash! Amma veetla nalla rest edukkattum, pathrama paathukkoanga.
h041.text: Amma is discharged and back home now.

h042.saheli: Deepavali preparation-ae oru thani sandhosham dhaan Prakash! Plan pannunga.
h042.text: Sorry late reply. Deepavali is coming up soon, need to plan sweets and clothes shopping.

h043.text: We are planning a family trip to Haridwar next month, tickets book pannanum.

h044.saheli: Aama Prakash, nariya thanni kudichu hydrated-a irunga.
h044.text: Inniku Chennai-la ore humid, veyil romba adikkudhu.

h045.saheli: Sema festive mood Prakash! Family kooda serndhu enjoy pannunga.
h045.text: Deepavali celebrations-kku crackers and special snacks list ready pandrom.

h046.text: Saheli, inniku kaalaila BP paathen, 150/88 irundhadhu. Prakash kitta sonnen note panni vechikka சொல்லி. Ippo light-a thala baram irukku maadhiri irukku.

h047.saheli: Romba nalladhu Lakshmi amma! Fresh air-la nadandhadhu udambukku romba koodudhal balam.
h047.text: Sayandhram konja neram motta maadiyila nadandhu mudichen. Kaaththu nalla vandhuchu, fresh air romba nalla irundhadhu. Walk mudichutu ippo vandhu ukkandhen.

h048.saheli: Neighbours kooda appappo updates therinjukkaradhu nalladhu Lakshmi amma.
h048.text: Namma flat secretary Ramasamy sir vandhirundhaar. Building maintenance pathi pesikittu irundhaar, avaru veetula ellarum sowkiyama nu visaarichen.

h049.saheli: Cool climate nalla irukkum Prakash, mazhai vandha pathram.
h049.text: Climate suddenly change aagudhu, cloudy and slight drizzle now.

h050.saheli: Paravalla Prakash, amma rest edukkattum. Udambu mukkiyam.
h050.text: Sorry late update. Evening walk skipped today, amma was resting.

h051.saheli: Nalla vishayam Lakshmi amma! Methuva unga speed-la nadandhadhe romba periya thiramai.
h051.text: Nethu sayandhram nalla walk poyitu vandhen Saheli. Hall-layum balcony-layum methuva nadandhen. Daily konjam nadandha dhaan kaal vali illama irukku.

h052.saheli: Kids school projects time consuming dhaan Prakash, but spend panradhu jolly dhaan.
h052.text: Sorry late reply. Kids had school project work today, full day helping them.

h053.saheli: Grandchildren kooda carrom aadinadhu Amma-vukku romba periya manamizhchi Prakash!
h053.text: Kids were playing carrom with amma in the evening, she was very happy.

h054.saheli: Kanna moodi rest edunga Prakash, mazhai nerathula veetukullaye safe-a irukaradhu dhaan nalladhu.
h054.text: Sorry for late text. Evening walk skipped today as it was raining heavily.

h055.saheli: Kutti pasanga unga kitta kadha kekkaradhe oru periya bhagyam Lakshmi amma! Nalla enjoy pannunga.
h055.text: Peran pethi ellam vandhu en kitta pazhaiya kadha kettanga. Naan chinna vayasula Nadanthadha sonnen, romba aachariyama kettanga. Pillaiyala sirikka vechadhe periya sandhosham.

h056.text: Deepavali cleaning started at home, bit tired.

h057.saheli: Kekkave romba perumaya irukku Lakshmi amma! Peranukku en vazhthukkal.
h057.text: Inniku peran school exam-la nalla marks vaangitan nu vandhu kaatnaan. En kaalula vizhundhu aashirvadham vaanginan. Enakku kannula thanniye vandhuruchu.

h059.saheli: Doctor appointment pathi Prakash kitta oru vaarthai கேட்டுக்குங்க Lakshmi amma, avaru correct date solliduvaaru.
h059.text: Saheli, adutha doctor visit eppo irukku nu unakku theriyuma? Marandhuten, checkup-kku poga vendiyadha irukku. Konjam paathu sollu pa.
